scores.tell: Chair legs and armrests are fat rounded tubes, with blobby yellow feet and a puffy seat. The thin frame parts are thickened into sausages.
Straight planar body with a tight rounded-box silhouette. Thin stand and bumper parts are present. The body is slightly pillowy at the corners.
The cauldron is a plain round belly with stubby cylindrical legs. Both handles are thick and the rim is soft, so it reads as a toy blob.
Jellyfish with a thin tentacle outline and a sensible bell shape. It is more organic and glossy than real cards, but the proportions work.
The ball is a perfect sphere with a fat, soft purple cap, and it has no flat or straight runs. The shape is overly toy-like.
Shapeless lumpy blob with swollen soft edges and holes, and the flames are bulbous droplets. It has no readable object structure.
The hut, posts, bar and stools have straight runs and a crisp thatch silhouette. Stool stems are a little fat.
A rounded-square player with a soft puffy body and thin cords kept thin. The corners are a bit blobby compared with real tight bevels.
The fruit pieces are plump but plausible, and the plate rim is clean and thin. The wedge and berries are slightly fattened.
